description: There is no composed/runnable 'config-drift detector' anywhere in the repo — only a library of pure functions (diffDeclaredVsActual, detectBrainDrift, detectRegistryStatusDrift, parseIndexLoopProcesses, resolveExpectedValue, classifyObservability) and thin I/O adapters (readPlistDeclaredEnv, readRuntimeEnvOfLabel, readRegistryFile, listRunningIndexLoopProcesses) in runtime/loop/config-drift.mjs. grep across the whole repo (`readPlistDeclaredEnv|readRuntimeEnvOfLabel|listRunningIndexLoopProcesses|detectBrainDrift|detectRegistryStatusDrift`) shows exactly two files reference these names at all: config-drift.mjs itself and its own unit test — nothing composes REQ-010's discovery output into REQ-001/002's comparisons and reports the REQ-004 fail-closed result as one 'run the detector' operation. Every EARS statement in behavioral-spec.md is phrased as 'WHEN config-drift detector が...実行される' (REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-010) and the NFR performance bound (behavioral-spec.md:401-405, '全体（REQ-001+REQ-002...)は5秒以内に完了する') presumes a single callable/executable detector — that artifact does not exist. In addition, REQ-008's required effectful primitive `queryLivePositions` (verification-architecture.md:41-45) is entirely unimplemented (0 matches anywhere in runtime/loop), and REQ-008's own acceptance criteria (behavioral-spec.md:297-306: real launchctl bootout/bootstrap restart, ANICCA_BRAIN=claude-p confirmed post-restart, position-parity check, shutdown-record-before-new-PID check) have zero corresponding evidence anywhere under .vcsdd/features/config-delivery-verification/ (only spec/iteration-1 and spec/iteration-2 review artifacts exist; no evidence/ directory, no fresh-evidence log). REQ-008 and its 3 fresh-evidence proof obligations (PROP-014/021/022, both explicitly Tier 0 'not CI, real-machine only' per verification-architecture.md:68,75-76) are therefore wholly unimplemented and unverified, not merely untested.

evidence.snippet: // No exported function anywhere in this file composes listRunningIndexLoopProcesses()+parseIndexLoopProcesses()+readPlistDeclaredEnv()+readRuntimeEnvOfLabel()+detectBrainDrift()/detectRegistryStatusDrift() into a single runnable check.

requiredFix: Add a top-level entrypoint (e.g. `runConfigDriftCheck()` or a CLI script analogous to skills/self/healthcheck-runtime-loop.sh's `check` orchestrator) that: (1) discovers live index.mjs processes via REQ-010, explicitly distinguishing 'zero targets found' from 'targets found, zero drift' per the REQ-010 edge case; (2) for each discovered target, reads its plist and runtime env (REQ-001) and its registry copy (REQ-002); (3) applies REQ-004 fail-closed classification uniformly; (4) returns one combined report within the NFR's 5-second bound. Implement `queryLivePositions` for REQ-008 and actually perform + record the launchctl bootout/bootstrap restart with fresh evidence (PROP-014/021/022) before this feature can be considered complete — none of this exists today.
